description: This file defines the GetRelationshipParams class, which extends BaseParam, and provides methods to access various parameters related to relationship retrieval in the API, such as module name, ID, linked field, source bean, pagination, sorting, and filtering.

classes.name: GetRelationshipParams
classes.description: Defines API parameters for retrieving related modules, including module name, ID, linked field name, source bean object, and optional pagination, sorting, and filtering parameters.

methods.name: getLinkedFieldName
methods.description: Returns the linked field name parameter.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Returns the page parameter, or initializes a new PageParams object if not set.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures the resolver with required options, default values, and dependencies for the parameters.
